section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: Organic Platformization Velocity vs. M&A-Driven Growth (CyberArk/Idira, Chronosphere & Console)
section_4b_pre_print_debates.consensus_view: Skeptical desks note Q1 FY27's +63% YoY NGS ARR guide ($9.54B–$9.56B) is heavily boosted by CyberArk (Idira) and Chronosphere consolidations, questioning underlying organic net-new ARR deceleration as FY27 full-year NGS ARR slows to +22%–23%.

Cross-selling CyberArk identity & Console agentic workflows creates unmatched AI-era consolidation.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.call_focus_question: CEO Nikesh Arora: What share of Q1 FY27 net-new NGS ARR was organic vs. CyberArk/Chronosphere, and how quickly is the newly acquired Console agentic platform monetizing within Cortex?

section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: Breaking the 4-Quarter 'Beat-and-Drop' Curse at 62.7x Forward P/E
section_4b_pre_print_debates.consensus_view: Despite beating EPS in all 4 trailing quarters (+4.35% to +9.88%), PANW shares fell after every single print (-9.28%, -5.64%, -6.82%, -7.42%) because rich 21.8x P/S and 62.7x Forward P/E multiples leave zero tolerance for merely in-line forward guidance.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.variant_perception: After pulling back to $305.70 (+30.4% upside to Street's $398.63 mean target), expectations for seasonal Q1 RPO ($20.8B–$20.9B) are well-calibrated; any FY27 revenue raise above $14.3B and Q2 guide >$3.52B can snap the post-print selloff streak.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.call_focus_question: CFO Dipak Golechha: With Q1 RPO guided for a normal seasonal sequential dip ($20.8B–$20.9B vs $21.2B in Q4), how does pipeline visibility support re-acceleration toward $25.2B–$25.4B FY27 RPO?

section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: GAAP Margin Dilution ($281M Intangibles Amortization, $487M SBC) vs. 38% Adjusted FCF Engine
section_4b_pre_print_debates.consensus_view: GAAP operating income compressed to $172M in Q4 FY26 (down from $497M YoY) with -$282M GAAP net loss due to $487M SBC, $281M acquired intangibles amortization, and -$441M other expense.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.variant_perception: Q4 FY26 generated $1,357M OCF and $1,254M Reported FCF (36.8% margin; $794M True FCF even net of SBC), and management targets 38.0% FY27 and 40.0% FY28 Adjusted FCF margins ($5B+ annual FCF), easily self-funding M&A integration.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.call_focus_question: CFO Dipak Golechha: How should institutional models pace acquired intangible amortization and SBC dilution across FY27 as CyberArk and Console integrate, and when does GAAP operating margin inflect back above 10%?
